links.outcome: AMI diagnostic AUC of AI-ECG versus HEART, GRACE 2.0, troponin, and physician score
links.effect: AI-ECG AUC 0.878 (95% CI 0.868-0.888), comparable with HEART 0.877 and superior to GRACE 2.0, hs-troponin, and Physician AMI score.
links.quote: The area under the receiver operating characteristic curve for AI-ECG was 0.878 (95% CI, 0.868-0.888), comparable with the HEART score (0.877; 95% CI, 0.869-0.886) and superior to the GRACE 2.0 score, high-sensitivity troponin level, and Physician AMI score.

screen.reason: Prospective multi-center validation of an AI-ECG model for rule-out of acute myocardial infarction in emergency department patients, assessing diagnostic accuracy rather than a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
